rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Closest: "the same move in prose" (L8), antecedent is the one-face-one-promise move of L4. Harm (unresolved referent on the wall) absent. Carve-out module-arc: lecture follows exercise apt101-paint-the-product-box in our-product-our-system.md L46-48.

No pointer to another file by position. Closest: "You drew the box" (L4) points at the exercise just done, a lived-module beat named by content (Product Box game), not by position; opener carve-out applies (our-product-our-system.md L46 exercise then L48 lecture).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "You drew the box" (L4) resolves: curriculum/exercises/apt101-paint-the-product-box.md exists and sits directly before lectures/apt101-work-backwards.md in the module include order (grep our-product-our-system.md L46/L48).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or live-demo beat; one chunk of prose

rules_evaluated.evidence: Single chunk carries three self-carrying claims (box test L4-6, working backwards L8). Closest to orphan: L6 "If you cannot write that face..." but it sits inside a full slide.

Header "Would a customer pick up the box?" is asked at L4 ("ask whether a customer would pick it up") and the slide answers the stakes at L6; L8 widens to the PR/FAQ without contradicting the header. Harm (header contradicted by content) absent.

Closest: L4 "One face, one promise, in words a customer would repeat." is a pair, not a triple; no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (no "Not" openers), no anaphora triple, no self-grading superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, no verb triplet. Observed by reading all 9 body lines; no grep run.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
